messages.subject: Plotting posterior sample draws
parts:
I've been scratching my head for a couple of hours now on how to plot out the draws from my model using the 'inla.posterior.sample" function. I would like to repeat the following for the draws:

curve(exp(-5.7696 + -0.0002 *x),xlab=" ",ylab=" ",lwd=2,xlim=c(0,24000))

-5.7696 is the mean effect for my intercept term and -0.0002 is the mean effect of my sole predictor term; and would like to repeat this for the 1000 draws. I know the values are stored in the latent variables, but the output of the posterior draws is proving difficult to manipulate. any help or guidance to material where this  has been done would be extremely helpful.

thanks

Hi Rue,

These are the 2 pieces of code i have been playing around with to extract the intercept and slope term for the 1000 draws (preferably in a two column matrix);

la<-t(sapply(post, function(x) x$latent)) 
colnames(la) <- c("Intercept", "gvillage")

p<-lapply (c("Intercept","gvillage"),
       function (x) grep(x, rownames(post[[1]]$latent),fixed=TRUE))

what i envisioned getting and what comes out are solar systems apart.
